name: veritrail-platform
description: Scopes the platform tree back to CommonJS: the repository root package.json declares "type": "module", which would make Node load the UMD website scripts (app/website/static/js) and the node:test files (tests/unit/js) as ESM and break require() in the Python test harness. Browser behaviour is unaffected; this file is not part of the built site.
